info.name: GigMaster API
info.description:
Complete API reference for GigMaster — multi-tenant job application management platform.

## Setup

1. Set `baseUrl` variable to your server (default: [http://localhost:4001](http://localhost:4001))
    
2. Call **Sign In** — the collection auto-saves the token to `{{authToken}}`
    
3. All authenticated requests use `{{authToken}}` automatically via the collection-level Auth tab
    

## Roles

- `SYSTEM_ADMIN` / `ADMIN` — global
    
- `ORG_ADMIN` — scoped to their org
    
- `AGENT` — own data only

request.description:
Run this BEFORE submitting an application.

**AGENT caller:** Returns `duplicate: true/false` and a message. Conflicting agent identity is NOT exposed.

**ORG_ADMIN caller:** Same, but also returns `filedByAgentId` and `filedAt` when a conflict exists.

Returns `200 OK` when clean, `409 Conflict` when a duplicate is found.

body.raw:
{
  "company": "TechFlow Systems e",
  "position": "Senior Backend Engineer t",
  "recruitingAgent": "Marcus Che rrrn",
  "platform": "LINKEDIN",
  "applicationType": "EASY_APPLY",
  "status": "INTERVIEW",
  "appliedDate": "2026-03-26",
  "notes": "First round technical interview focused on Spring Boot and system design."
}

request.description:
The Duplicate Shield runs automatically before saving.
If another agent in your org applied to the same company in the last 30 days on an active application, you will receive a `409 Conflict` response instead.

- **AGENT**: returns only their own applications within their org.
- **ORG_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN**: returns all applications in the org.
AGENT can only fetch their own application. Attempting to fetch another agent's application returns 404 (not 403 — to avoid leaking existence).

request.description:
Available statuses:
- `PENDING`
- `SUBMITTED`
- `UNDER_REVIEW`
- `INTERVIEW_SCHEDULED`
- `OFFERED`
- `REJECTED`
- `WITHDRAWN`

**AGENT**: may only set `WITHDRAWN` on their own application.
**ORG_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN**: may set any status.

body.raw:
{
  "applicationId": "{{appId}}",
  "interviewDateTime": "2026-04-12T14:00:00",
  "interviewerName": "Alex Chen",
  "interviewerPhone": "+263-77-123-4567",
  "documentsRequired": "Original ID, Driver's License, and 2 References",
  "locationOrLink": "https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij",
  "notes": "Candidate requested a late afternoon slot due to current work commitments.",
  "status": "SCHEDULED"

}

request.description:
Only ORG_ADMIN and SYSTEM_ADMIN can schedule interviews.
The `applicationId` must belong to the same org as the caller.

- **AGENT**: own interviews only.
- **ORG_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN**: all interviews in the org.
